item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00144","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C07","C14","C16"],"selected_candidate_label":"C07","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C07 is an immediately preceding installment of the same Selective Service Regulations and supplies the later directive's concrete drafting framework: the virtually identical prescribing clause, codified-part organization, local-board procedures, registrant classifications, records, and recurring SSS forms. The child extends that framework with Parts 628 onward, including physical examination procedures that expressly depend on classifications and records prescribed in C07. C14 is also foundational to the same regulatory series, and C16 directly amends portions of that series, but neither is as close a template for the child's form and installment structure as C07.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I hereby prescribe the following portions of the regulations governing the administration of Title I of the said Act, which shall constitute portions of Parts 628, 629, 631, 6532, 641, and 642 of Chapter VI of Title 32 of the Code of Federal Regulations, such regulations to be known as the Selective Service Regulations","parent_excerpt":"I hereby prescribe the following portions of the regulations governing the administration of Title I of the said Act, which shall constitute portions of Parts 621 to 627, inclusive, of Title 32, chapter VI, Code of Federal Regulations, such regulations to be known as the Selective Service Regulations","explanation":"This distinctive, nearly verbatim prescribing clause establishes that the child was drafted as a subsequent installment using C07's exact regulatory promulgation template."},{"child_excerpt":"The local board shall review the classification of the registrant and if it finds under the provisions of Part 622 of this chapter that he should be placed in some other class, reopen his classification and classify him anew and mail him a Notice of Classification (SSS Form No. 110).","parent_excerpt":"PART 622-CLASSIFICATION RULES AND PRINCIPLES ... It is the local board's responsibility to decide, subject to appeal, the class in which each registrant shall be placed.","explanation":"The child incorporates and operationalizes the classification machinery prescribed in C07 rather than merely sharing a broad subject."},{"child_excerpt":"Prepare an original and two copies of the Record of Induction (NME Form No. 47) ... Enter under \"Minutes of Actions by Local Board and Appeal Board\" on the Classification Questionnaire (SSS Form No. 100)","parent_excerpt":"Classification Questionnaire (SSS Form No. 100) ... Cover Sheet (SSS Form No. 101) ... Classification Record (SSS Form No. 102)","explanation":"Both directives use the same detailed forms-based administrative system, with the child extending C07's recordkeeping workflow into medical screening and armed-forces examination."}]}
